purpose: Bridge connected football-impact cases into team scoring and game-market comparison without allowing sportsbook prices to create or rewrite football projections.

market_team_total_derivation.note: market_home_spread uses standard sportsbook sign convention: negative means home favorite

reassessment_states.PENDING_FOOTBALL_RECALCULATION: Connected event requires team-scoring review but the existing football projection has not yet been regenerated from changed football inputs.
reassessment_states.READY_FOR_MARKET_COMPARISON: Football projection exists and required market fields exist.
reassessment_states.INSUFFICIENT_MARKET_DATA: Football projection exists but required market fields are unavailable.
reassessment_states.NO_CURRENT_GAME: Affected team has no verified current-week game.
reassessment_states.NO_TEAM_SCORING_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Connected case does not require team-scoring or market-comparison review.
